summary: Added compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults to ClientArgsCreator in botocore/args.py, which returns endpoint ruleset builtin parameter values (AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, SDK::Endpoint, plus STS and S3-specific builtins). Added unit tests in tests/unit/test_args.py. tests/unit/test_args.py, tests/unit/test_client.py and tests/functional/test_regions.py pass (679 tests). Nothing is committed. The builtin parameter list was my choice since the spec does not enumerate it.
